from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

USER = 'leonh'
checks = [
    Path('/mnt/g/My Drive'),
    Path('/mnt/g/Shared drives'),
    Path(f'/mnt/c/Users/{USER}/My Drive'),
    Path(f'/mnt/c/Users/{USER}/Google Drive'),
    Path(f'/mnt/c/Users/{USER}/Google Drive/My Drive'),
]
install_checks = [
    Path('/mnt/c/Program Files/Google/Drive File Stream'),
    Path('/mnt/c/Program Files/Google/Drive'),
    Path(f'/mnt/c/Users/{USER}/AppData/Local/Google/DriveFS'),
]
mounts = []
root = Path('/mnt')
if root.exists():
    for p in sorted(root.iterdir()):
        if p.is_dir() and len(p.name) == 1 and p.name.isalpha():
            mounts.append(str(p))
rows = []
for p in checks:
    rows.append({
        'path': str(p),
        'exists': p.exists(),
        'is_dir': p.is_dir(),
        'writable_by_current_user': bool(p.exists() and os.access(p, os.W_OK)),
    })
installed = [str(p) for p in install_checks if p.exists()]
ready = [r for r in rows if r['is_dir'] and r['writable_by_current_user']]
result = {
    'schema': 'PREDICTION_DRIVE_RESULT_PREFLIGHT_V1',
    'mounted_windows_drives': mounts,
    'google_drive_desktop_install_evidence': installed,
    'candidate_sync_paths': rows,
    'ready_paths': ready,
    'ready_for_export': bool(ready),
    'credentials_read': False,
    'external_write_attempted': False,
}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
print('DRIVE_RESULT_PREFLIGHT_E014=PASS')
print('READY_FOR_EXPORT=' + ('TRUE' if ready else 'FALSE'))
